usage.finalMessage:
I added `next-free <clinician> <time>` and listed it in `help` right after `schedule`. `dotnet test Clinic.slnx` passes (6/6), and the work is committed.
`next-free` looks up to 60 days ahead, the limit in DEC-C05 (the booking-horizon decision in force). `book` still allows 90 days under the replaced DEC-C01, because an existing test requires that.
The report's open questions ask Clinical Operations to confirm whether `book` should move to 60 days.

OUTCOME: completed
